structured_output.summary: In src/game.ts, the resume branch of setPaused now calls input.reset() before ui.resume() and startLoop(), as the pause branch already does. Before this, a Space keydown on the pause card set the keyboard's actionTapped latch. Resuming never cleared it, so the first input.read() after resume returned action: true and fired an armed player's boost. Resetting on resume clears every latch and key pressed while paused. The sim, physics and replays are unchanged. Added tests/game/pause-action-latch.test.ts, the verifier's test. It arms car 0 on Dust Bowl, then sends Esc, Space down/up and Esc, runs 3 frames and expects boostTicks 0 and armed still true.
